verses.text: Mamin Jehová, tzach in b'itej yet' in wach' lolonel, yujto ix in a sik'k'e waan t'a skal in niwan yaelal, maj in a cha b'uchjok yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Mamin, in Diosal ach, ix in k'an a kolwal, ix ak'an b'oxok in k'ool.
Mamin, a ach ton ix in a kolel t'a chamel. Ix ak' in k 'inal, maj in a chab'atlaj t'a skal heb' chamnak.
B'itananhek t'a Jehová, mach ex to schonhab' ex, b'itejek yujto anhej Te Niwan Yelk'ochi.
Yujto junnhej rato ay yowal sk'ool, haxo swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Wach'chom tzonh ok' t'ak'walil, haxo yik sk'inhib'i sja ko tzalajk'olal.
Ayik te wach' waji, ix in na' icha tik: Malaj b'ak'inh ol in telwok yuj junok tas, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, yuj wal swach'il a k'ool, ix in ak'kanoch b'aj malaj tas tzin ik'ani. Palta ayik ix ik'anel a b'a t'ayin, ix somchajkanel in k'ool.
Mamin, ix ach wawtej, ix walan in b'a t'ayach:

¿Tasto a ganar t'ayin, k'inalok tato tzin chami, tzin mukchaji? Manhxo ol yal-laj ach sb'itan heb' toxo ix och pokokal. Manh ol yal pax laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach yuj swach'il tas ix a b'o'o, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, ab' wal tas swala', ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin. Mamin, ochannhej wet'ok.
Ix ak'an k'exmaj in yaelal t'a tzalajk'olal. Ix ik'anel in kusk'olal, ix ak'ankanoch k'apak pichul yik k'inh in pichulok.
Yuj wal chi' jun, ach Jehová in Diosal, max yal-laj wem numan. Tzin b'itan t'ayach t'a aloj wach' lolonel yet' ak'oj yuj diosal t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
